text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: Although the paper uses spatial modeling and future climate scenarios to project changes in emergent aquatic macrophyte distributions across Finland (national scale), its primary focus is ecological—specifically on species distribution modeling under climate change—not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. The vegetation data are derived from a subclass of the CORINE land-cover classification, but the study treats emergent macrophytes as ecological indicators rather than modeling LULC change per se. The research question centers on climate-driven shifts in species presence and cover, falling under species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC prediction, which triggers exclusion criterion: "Species-specific/ecological focus (flora/fauna) unrelated to LULC.")
